verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with API-key auth, downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 specs, a Try-it playground, date-based versioning and an MCP server, but no official SDK or client library in any language. An OpenAPI spec is only a developer building block for generating clients, and the MCP server is a different capability, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
